body.title: Contract test pinning the parameters of each guarded search request
body.summary: Before the guard is added (decision q4e48e4a6), a test that calls each graph-reading request of src/daemon/index.ts (search.callers, search.callees, search.callers_nhop, search.by_file, search.closure, entity.summary, entity.closure, entity.unreachable, repo.depends_on, repo.search_cross_repo, locate.inferParents, search.query) with its existing parameters against a temporary store and asserts each is accepted and answers, so a change to a handler's params fails the test.
acceptanceChecks: The test passes on the code before the guard and names each request it pins.
Renaming or removing a parameter a handler reads (a mutation) makes it fail.

tests.name: search request contract: each guarded search request accepts its existing params and answers
